visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a handheld shot from a moving scooter navigating a very narrow residential alleyway in Taiwan during daytime. A red circle highlights a small stall in the distance. (2) The camera cuts to a medium shot of a stainless steel food cart labeled 'Tanaka Stinky Tofu' with several customers waiting. (3) Extreme close-up of a person wearing purple gloves using a knife to slice open pieces of golden-brown fried tofu on a black tray. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor restaurant setting where a young woman with long black hair wearing a colorful knit sweater (Zoe) and a young man with glasses (her brother) are sitting at a table talking. (5) A plate of stinky tofu topped with a generous amount of pickled cabbage is presented. (6) Zoe and her brother engage in a lively conversation, pointing at the food while their mother sits nearby in a pink sweater. (7) Another man in a white t-shirt joins the table, takes a bite of the tofu, and shares his reaction. (8) The group continues their meal, showing facial expressions of surprise and humor as they discuss the taste and the mother's recommendation. (9) Close-up shots of the tofu and cabbage are interspersed with reaction shots of the family laughing and talking together in the brightly lit indoor space.
